decisions.rationale: Test fully set-based execution to minimize gets, alongside moderate bulk and cache variants to map trade-offs between buffer cache reads and PGA usage across all loops.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts logical I/O at higher memory. Test combining SET_BASED upsert (s5) with cached lookups and bulk processing, or testing single-site cache tradeoffs to map the f1 vs f2 frontier.
Test caching only s2 while leaving s3 SET_BASED to discover intermediate trade-offs between low memory (~2.3MB) and low logical I/O (~5.8k gets), exploring asymmetric cache allocations.

LOOKUP_CACHE dominates I/O reduction, while SET_BASED at s5 minimizes memory. Testing combinations where only s2 or s4 uses cache with ROW/BULK options explores the gap between 2.3MB-2.8MB and 15MB+ PGA.
Test isolating single lookup cache (s4 only) to find lower memory trade-offs, and test BULK_5000 combinations to explore lower consistent gets.
Evaluate SET_BASED with BULK_5000 on s4 cache, explore lower-memory cache combinations, and check BULK_5000 on s3 alone to push Pareto boundaries on gets versus PGA.

Test lower PGA boundary combinations: evaluate whether SET_BASED on s1 and s3 without LOOKUP_CACHE can reduce PGA below 2304KB with BULK or ROW on s5, and explore minimal BULK combinations under LOOKUP_CACHE.
Explores hybrid configurations with s2 cached and s4 SQL, combining low logical I/O from s1 batching with lower PGA overhead than double caching.
Test caching on s4 only with BULK options on s3, combined with SET_BASED or low-memory options on s1, to explore trade-offs between low f1 and lower f2.
Test BULK_5000 in s3 with s1 BULK_50/ROW or s3 BULK_5000 with s1 SET_BASED/ROW to find Pareto-optimal f1 below 5812 or explore low memory boundaries.
Test fully set-based execution to minimize consistent gets, plus intermediate bulk variations with lookup caching to explore trade-offs between memory and logical reads.

LOOKUP_CACHE drastically reduces f1 while increasing memory. Combining SET_BASED with LOOKUP_CACHE where applicable, or varying batch sizes for bulk operations, helps map the low-f1 and intermediate memory trade-off space.
Test caching only one lookup site to probe intermediate memory overheads, and test SET_BASED at s1 or s3 combined with LOOKUP_CACHE at the other.
Test SET_BASED for s1/s3 paired with LOOKUP_SQL while varying s5, and explore lower BULK limits with LOOKUP_CACHE to optimize the f1-f2 trade-off between 2.3MB and 15MB.
Test caching only s2 with SET_BASED downstream, and explore low-limit bulk on s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE and ROW/SET_BASED permutations to discover lower-memory cache configurations.
Test BULK_500 on s1 paired with ROW on s3 and cache combinations to bridge the trade-off gap between 24.8k and 5.8k gets while checking lower memory limits.
Test BULK_5000 on s1 with BULK_500 on s3 and s5=SET_BASED, explore LOOKUP_CACHE memory trade-offs with ROW on s1, and evaluate intermediate bulk sizes on s3 to improve Pareto resolution.
Test s2/s4 LOOKUP_CACHE asymmetric splits with SET_BASED and ROW/BULK variants, targeting intermediate trade-offs between f1 and f2.
Test lower memory limits for s1/s3 cache variants and explore unmeasured s5=SET_BASED pure SQL configurations that may beat the current f2 boundary (2304KB).
Exploring the low-memory, low-gets frontier around SET_BASED/SQL configurations: BULK_50 on s1 or s3 with LOOKUP_SQL and SET_BASED s5 offers low PGA while reducing gets compared to ROW.
Test pure SET_BASED across all loops for minimal logical I/O, alongside varying BULK and LOOKUP_CACHE combinations to explore memory and buffer cache trade-offs.
LOOKUP_CACHE achieves massive f1 reduction at high f2 cost. Test caching selectively or pairing BULK loops with LOOKUP_SQL to find balanced trade-offs between 2.3MB and 16.5MB memory.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces f1 while SET_BASED at s5 minimizes memory overhead. Testing BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_CACHE and s5=SET_BASED pushes f1 lower, while exploring caching only s2 isolates memory trade-offs.
Test mix of BULK and ROW or smaller batch sizes with LOOKUP_SQL to probe memory-efficient configurations, and test single cache lookup at s2 to see if memory can be halved.
Test single-cache configurations with ROW loops to explore the trade-off between f2 (minimal PGA overhead) and f1 reduction from caching only one table.
Test combinations of ROW and BULK on s1/s3 without LOOKUP_CACHE to optimize f2 and f1 simultaneously, and test s1=BULK_500 with s3=ROW/LOOKUP_CACHE to improve the low-f1 trade-off.
Test single-lookup cache combinations with BULK/SET to isolate cache overhead, and check smaller bulk sizes combined with cache to find intermediate Pareto points between 5814 and 182295.
Combine LOOKUP_CACHE at s2 and SET_BASED at s3 or test smaller bulk sizes with single caches to probe gaps between low-PGA/high-gets and high-PGA/low-gets regions.
Test BULK_5000 in s1/s3 combinations with LOOKUP_CACHE to challenge minimum f1, and test ROW variants without cache to probe low f2.
Test BULK_5000 on both s1 and s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE to check if f1 improves past 5812, test s1=SET_BASED s3=BULK without LOOKUP_CACHE, and explore intermediate low-memory combinations.
Evaluate SET_BASED across loops to dramatically reduce consistent gets, while testing intermediate BULK and cached lookups to explore PGA trade-offs.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces gets (2%) at high memory cost. Testing BULK with LOOKUP_CACHE only on s2 or s4 isolates memory impact, while testing SET_BASED combined with cache/bulk explores the Pareto trade-off.

LOOKUP_CACHE dominates logical I/O reduction, but consumes ~14MB memory. We test isolated caching on s2 and s4 with moderate bulk sizing and SET_BASED to discover intermediate trade-off points on the Pareto front.
Explore whether caching only s2 while keeping s3 SET_BASED or caching only s4 yields lower PGA intermediate points, and test ROW variants without cache for minimal PGA.
Test low-memory configurations combining SET_BASED at s5 with single caches at s2 or s4 to explore the missing trade-offs between 2MB and 15MB PGA.
Testing LOOKUP_CACHE at s2 combined with SET_BASED or SQL at s3/s5 to map the mid-memory frontier, plus exploring low-memory intermediate BULK options with s5=SET_BASED.
Test caching only s2 while keeping s3/s4/s5 minimal or set-based to isolate s2 memory overhead and map intermediate trade-offs between 1.9MB and 15MB.

Test s1 BULK_500 with s3 SET_BASED or s3 BULK_500 to evaluate fine-grained memory/buffer trade-offs around the Pareto boundary, especially variations combining LOOKUP_SQL with SET_BASED and ROW alternatives.
Evaluating BULK_5000 on s1 and s3 with combinations of caching and SET_BASED to discover minimum f1 gains against high-memory bulk thresholds.
Explores minimal PGA boundaries around SET_BASED and tests selective LOOKUP_CACHE combinations between s1 and s3 to find missing intermediate Pareto trade-offs.
Test fully set-based execution to drastically minimize buffer gets (f1), alongside moderate bulk and cache variants to map the memory vs consistent gets trade-off.
LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces gets (f1) while BULK/SET_BASED controls PGA (f2). Testing BULK_50 with cache and SET_BASED combinations explores low memory and low I/O trade-offs across loops.
Combine BULK_5000 at s1/s3 with caching and SET_BASED at s5 to test lowest f1, plus test selective LOOKUP_CACHE caching at either s2 or s4 to explore intermediate PGA trade-offs.

Test combinations of BULK/CACHE in s1 and SET_BASED/SQL elsewhere to bridge low-PGA and low-gets trade-offs, particularly testing BULK_5000 with s5=SET_BASED and mixed caching with low memory footprints.
Evaluating row/bulk combinations with single cache usage to map the intermediate memory frontier between 2.3MB and 15MB, alongside testing if BULK_5000 in s3 improves f1 over BULK_500.
Test lower limit sizes and hybrid caching configurations to explore memory vs gets trade-offs around s5=SET_BASED.
Test low-memory alternatives with s2/s4 LOOKUP_SQL to bridge the low PGA and low gets gap, and test pure low f1 bulk combinations.
Evaluating ROW on both s1 and s3 alongside SET_BASED s5 with LOOKUP_SQL to target low PGA memory (<1984KB), while also exploring SET_BASED across alternative combinations without cache.
Test alternative low-memory configurations around s1=ROW and SET_BASED combinations with LOOKUP_SQL, and explore BULK_5000 lookup variants.
Test caching only s2 or only s4 with row/bulk variants to uncover intermediate memory-IO trade-offs around 14-15MB PGA, and evaluate bulk sizes for s5 on the low-gets frontier.
Test pure SET_BASED across all loops to dramatically minimize logical reads, alongside bulk options (BULK_500, BULK_5000) and caching to evaluate buffer gets versus PGA memory trade-offs.
LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts f1 by 98% but uses 16MB. Test mixing SET_BASED with LOOKUP_CACHE, and evaluate row-level or low-batch variants with cache to locate intermediate f1-f2 trade-offs.
Evaluating BULK_500 for s1/s3 with s5=SET_BASED, plus isolated LOOKUP_CACHE at s1 to explore the tradeoff between f1 reduction and cache memory overhead.
LOOKUP_CACHE dominates memory. Test s1=SET_BASED with s4=LOOKUP_CACHE to measure per-cache memory, and test BULK_5000 on s1/s3 to push f1 lower than 5814 under cache.
Test combinations of LOOKUP_CACHE at s2 only to explore intermediate PGA regimes around 8-10MB, plus fine-tuning bulk limits around the Pareto frontier at low f1.
Test BULK_50/500 mixtures with LOOKUP_CACHE for lower PGA than BULK_5000, and evaluate pure SQL lookups with mixed SET_BASED/ROW structures to bridge intermediate memory-consistent get regions.
Test BULK_50 on s5 with BULK_500 for s1/s3 cache to see if f1 is minimized below config 19, or test s1/s3 cache combinations targeting PGA near 15-16MB with lower f1.
Investigate lower memory trade-offs using LOOKUP_CACHE only on s4 or s2, and test if BULK_5000 on s1 with BULK_50 on s5 reaches lower logical reads.
Test BULK_5000 combinations targeting low consistent gets, and test ROW/BULK_50 on s5 with low-memory SET_BASED/SQL setups to probe the boundary.
Test BULK_5000 at s1 with BULK_5000/500 to beat f1=5780, and test ROW at s3 with BULK_5000 at s1 to explore low-memory lookup cache trade-offs.
Test fully set-based execution to drastically minimize buffer gets (f1), alongside intermediate bulk sizes with lookup caches to sample memory-f1 trade-offs.
LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces f1 at high PGA cost. Combining SET_BASED DML loops with selective caching or BULK processing tests low-PGA, low-f1 intermediate trade-offs across the Pareto front.
Test cache on s2 vs s4 independently with SET_BASED s5, and explore BULK_5000 with SET_BASED s5 to find minimal f1 and intermediate f2 values.
Evaluating intermediate PGA regimes by caching only one lookup while exploring lower batch sizes or SET_BASED variants to find pareto-optimal points between low memory and low logical I/O.
Test fine-grained bulk limits and row variants with LOOKUP_CACHE to discover lower PGA trade-offs under low f1, while keeping SET_BASED for s5 which consistently dominates.
Test BULK_5000 on s1 or s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE to optimize f1, and test ROW variants without cache to explore intermediate memory levels.
Test low-memory configurations around evaluated #31 (f2=1984KB) to find further memory reductions or trade-offs with ROW/SET_BASED mixtures using LOOKUP_SQL.
Explores low-memory frontier by pairing SQL lookup with BULK/SET variants on s1/s3/s5, and tests whether caching only s2 or s4 yields intermediate memory benefits.
Test BULK_50/BULK_500 on s1 with ROW on s3 without cache to probe low-memory trade-offs, and check BULK_50 combinations with cache targeting borderline f1/f2 Pareto improvements.
Test BULK_5000 on S1 with BULK_50/5000 on S3 with cache, and explore low-memory boundaries with SET_BASED/ROW combinations.
Test pure SET_BASED across all loops for minimal logical I/O, then explore intermediate bulk limits and lookup caching to map out the memory versus gets Pareto boundary.
LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts logical I/O while BULK_50 or SET_BASED for s5 curbs memory footprint.
LOOKUP_CACHE achieves massive f1 reduction (2%) but inflates PGA to ~16MB. Test SET_BASED at s1 while caching s4/BULK at s3, and test SQL lookups combined with SET_BASED to bridge the trade-off.
Test single-cache configurations with smaller batch sizes to isolate memory footprint and evaluate intermediate trade-offs between f1 reduction and PGA overhead.
Test s1=BULK_5000 with s3=BULK_500 and s5=SET_BASED to probe minimum f1 among dual caches, plus explore combinations of SET_BASED and ROW on s5 to refine memory trade-offs.
Evaluating configurations testing ROW at s5 with LOOKUP_CACHE at s1/s3 or exploring s1/s3 ROW with caches to see if lower PGA is achievable around the ultra-low f1 frontier.
Test lower memory trade-offs around s4=LOOKUP_CACHE with ROW/BULK_50 on s3/s1, and explore whether BULK_50 with LOOKUP_CACHE achieves lower PGA than BULK_500 while preserving low logical reads.
Test caching on s2 only (with s3=SET_BASED or s4=LOOKUP_SQL) to explore intermediate PGA (below 15MB) and lower gets than purely SQL-based setups.
Test minimal memory footprint combinations with ROW/BULK_50 under LOOKUP_SQL and SET_BASED s1 to push low-f2 boundary, and test BULK_50 variations around the low f1/f2 trade-off frontiers.
Eval 44 achieved the lowest f2 (1984KB). Testing s1=ROW vs s5 variations and exploring if combining s1=ROW with s3=BULK without LOOKUP_CACHE achieves low memory with lower f1 than eval 44.
Test fully set-based execution to minimize gets, alongside moderate bulk options and lookup caching to explore trade-offs between memory and logical I/O across loops.

LOOKUP_CACHE drastically reduces f1 at high memory cost. Testing BULK_5000 with cache pushes minimum f1, while mixing SET_BASED with caching explores intermediate trade-offs between f1 and memory consumption.
Explore intermediate PGA and f1 by testing LOOKUP_CACHE at s2 while keeping s3/s4/s5 in ROW or SET_BASED without s4 cache, or BULK with LOOKUP_SQL to isolate cache memory overhead.

Caching s2 yields dramatic f1 reduction while s4 caching may be redundant or expensive. Testing partial caching (s2=LOOKUP_CACHE, s4=LOOKUP_SQL) with bulk and set-based options explores the low-memory/intermediate I/O tradeoff.

Test lower memory footprint with caching by combining ROW or smaller BULK with LOOKUP_CACHE, and test ROW on s5 with low-read caching configurations to find lower memory trade-offs near the 5.8k-7.2k f1 knee.
Test minimal memory configs by combining SET_BASED at s1/s5 with ROW or small bulk sizes on s3 without cache, and test ROW caching to find lower-PGA points on the cache-based front.
Test whether BULK_5000 on s1 further reduces gets when paired with cache and SET_BASED, explore s1 ROW with cache variations, and check low-memory frontier options around ROW/SET combinations.

Evaluating intermediate PGA configurations: caching only one lookup table while keeping SET_BASED/ROW or small BULK combinations can yield low f2 (~8-10MB) and intermediate f1, bridging the 2MB to 15MB PGA gap.
Test lower PGA variants around low-f1 regions and explore intermediate PGA trade-offs using ROW/BULK_50 combinations with LOOKUP_SQL and SET_BASED DMLs.
Test BULK_5000 at both s1 and s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE to see if f1 improves further below 5812, and explore SET_BASED at s1/s3 without LOOKUP_CACHE to optimize the low-PGA region.

Test pure SET_BASED across all loops to establish an aggressive baseline for minimum consistent gets, alongside balanced bulk approaches paired with caching to evaluate the memory-vs-I/O tradeoff space efficiently.
Test BULK_500 with LOOKUP_SQL to isolate cache memory costs, and SET_BASED combined with selective BULK_500/LOOKUP_CACHE to explore the trade-off between logical reads and memory.

LOOKUP_CACHE dominates LIO reduction while s1/s5 SET_BASED reduces gets. Exploring BULK_5000 with s5=SET_BASED, single-cache configurations, and hybrid combinations to map the memory vs LIO tradeoff front.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces logical I/O at higher PGA. Testing ROW with selective caching, minimal bulk sizes (BULK_50), and caching only one lookup will explore intermediate PGA trade-offs between 2.3MB and 15MB.
Test caching only s4 versus s2 with SET_BASED/ROW combinations to explore lower memory usage with partial cache, and evaluate pure ROW caching with SET_BASED s1 to balance gets and PGA.

LOOKUP_CACHE provides huge f1 reductions while s5=SET_BASED minimizes f1/f2. Exploring hybrid cache vs bulk variations, particularly s1=BULK + s3=ROW and other intermediate bulk limits, to fill the Pareto front between 5.8k and 65k f1.
Test BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_CACHE combinations to see if larger bulk size reduces logical I/O below 5814 blocks, while exploring low memory boundaries between BULK and SET_BASED.
Test lower PGA boundary when s1 uses BULK without lookup caching or when s3 caches alone, and refine frontier around low f1/PGA trade-offs.
Test s1/s3 SET_BASED combinations with LOOKUP_CACHE and BULK configurations on the opposing sites to find low f1/f2 Pareto trade-offs.
Test BULK_50 on s1 and s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE to balance low gets and minimal collection memory, and explore hybrid caching with SET_BASED.
